description: When the bundle fails, the static shell shows the new failure text ("rebuild the browser client and restart the service") but keeps the earlier "If this page does not open, check that Pardner is running (pardner open)" paragraph, giving two diagnoses at once. With JS disabled the running-check paragraph appears above "Enable JavaScript".
expected: One message per failure state, the specific one replacing the generic one.
suggested_fix: Hide the generic paragraph when the failure text or noscript message is shown.

description: The static startup shell's heading (~20px) and column (left edge 505px at 1440 wide) differ from the React startup/sign-in screens (heading ~28px; left edge 485px for signed-out and identity screens), so the page visibly jumps when the app mounts. The inline code font is a Courier fallback in Chromium on both.
expected: Shell styles identical to the first React screen, so the handoff is seamless.
actual: Heading size and 20px horizontal shift on mount.
suggested_fix: Share the container width/heading styles between index.html inline CSS and the React startup screens.

description: A /pardner/config response of `{}` (no mode, no apiBase) is shown as the standalone notice "This is an agent and integration service. Open Pardner with pardner open." instead of the incomplete-configuration message.
expected: "The local client configuration is incomplete. Restart Pardner and retry."
suggested_fix: Treat the standalone notice as requiring a standalone-shaped config (apiBase present); otherwise show the incomplete message.
